title: Relay Hazard Prep
subtitle: Weather-aware route planning before deeper danger
summary: The relay route is not a toxic swamp or reactor ruin, but exposure still matters. Weather windows and return markers are part of the objective.
body: Check for toxic-front warnings before leaving shelter.
Bring filters, clean water, food, a charged scanner, and enough repair material to avoid wasting the trip.
Bio Lab, Reactor, and Data Center markers should remain future warnings until relay-route smoke proves the player has counterplay.
